Facts: The deceased’s collateral heirs challenged a holographic will, alleging it was not entirely handwritten by the testator.
Legal framework: Articles 602 Civil Code; 217(2) Code of Civil Procedure; action for negative assessment of authorship.
Interpretative issue: Allocation of the burden of proof in disputes over the authenticity of a holographic will.
Principle applied: The party contesting the authenticity of a holographic will bears the full burden of proving non-authorship; the action raises a quaestio inexistentiae aimed at excluding the will’s effects, without requiring the beneficiary to formally rely on the deed.
